events.text:
T-071 stays in review for Bhaskar and Bharath. The T-074 ripple needed no change: buyers already get the coaching link through the team's access email and the buyer-only course page.

- **Orchestrator note F-e0252148 (items 1 to 4):** the 2026-10-10 runs logged these as done. I did not redo or recheck them this run, except the republished mirror: the live /pro page is the one I probed below.
- **Live /pro check:** done this run. `probe-pro.mjs` ran against the live mirror and reported ALL PASS.
- **Ripple R-d1bf54ad (show the coaching link after purchase):** no change needed. I checked on disk that the link already reaches buyers two ways:
  - step 2 of `workshop-plan/pro/moderation-rota.md` has the team email each new buyer their access, including the coaching call link;
  - the buyer-only course home shows it (`cloud/src/course.ts:97`, settings key `pro_coaching_url`).

  I left the raw Zoom link off the public `/pro?paid=1` thank-you banner on purpose. Anyone can open that URL, so putting it there would publish a members-only meeting link. The banner already says coaching access comes by email.
- **Status and notes:** T-071 is set to review and both notes are acknowledged. I changed no files, so there was nothing to commit.
